head: codex/5592-runtime-v3-parity-b
title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][runtime-v3][parity-b] Make reasoning, adaptive learning, and governed cognition live
body:
Closes #5592

Implements signed-policy Runtime v3 Parity-B graph execution through the production guardian, TLS signed /v1/control API, canonical ingress, narrow schema router, and persistent configured executor. It includes deterministic bounded loop resume, authenticated semantic checkpoints, one-shot governed adaptation that survives restart, advisory-signal isolation, monotonic Freedom Gate and shutdown authority, and evidence-specific feature dispositions without Runtime v2 or AWS.

Exact proof passes all seven issue lanes, the external guardian-launched black-box test, the complete Runtime v3 suite, strict all-target Clippy, formatting, dependency isolation, and diff hygiene. Fresh exact review has zero actionable findings. Runtime v3 is 13,547 physical source lines, an explicitly accepted cohesive-scope exception of +1,338 over the pinned 12,209 baseline and +1,547 over the reviewed target, below the 20,000 hard ceiling.
